title: Qabsashada Dhulka
intro: Waqtigii tijaabooyinka waaweyn, qof caan ah waxaa la siiyay hodantinimo aad u weyn oo adduunyo ah, imtixaan mahadnaq iyo is-hoosaysiin ah. Safarka qofkan wuxuu u yahay cashar qoto dheer oo ku saabsan dabeecadda soo daahday ee hantida maadiga ah iyo cawaaqibka kibirka. Soo bandhig aqoonsiga naftan oo sheekadeedu ku duugan tahay dhulka hoostiisa.
clues: Waxaan ku noolaa dad uu hoggaaminayo rasuul weyn.
Ilaahay wuxuu i siiyay hanti aad u badan oo furaha khasnadahaygu culays culus ku ahaa shakhsiyaad badan oo xoog leh.
Dadkaygu, iyagoo og hantidayda, waxay igula taliyeen inaan guriga Aakhiro ku raadiyo waxa Alle i siiyay oo aanan iloobin qaybtayda adduunka, oo aan wanaag sameeyo sida Alle ii sameeyay.
Waxaan si kibir leh u sheegay in hantidayda aadka u badan lagu gaaray aqoontayda iyo dadaalkayga oo keliya, anigoo diidaya wax nimco ah oo rabbaani ah.
Markii la i weydiistay inaan wax ku darsado ama aan qiro nimcada Alle, waan iska diiday anigoo aaminsan in hantidaydu ay tahay tayda oo keliya.
Natiijo ahaan kibir iyo dulmigii xad-dhaafka ahaa awgeed, Alle wuxuu amray in dhulka la furo oo la liqo aniga iyo gurigayga.

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Ku noolaanshaha nolol dheer oo cibaado leh
Burbur baahsan oo ay sabab u tahay isla weynida
outcome.answer: Burbur baahsan oo ay sabab u tahay isla weynida

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
